claim: Block public access for AMIs is enabled by default for new accounts and for existing accounts with no public AMIs, but it is disabled by default for an account that had one or more public AMIs on or after July 15, 2023, even if all its AMIs are now private, and for existing accounts with one or more public AMIs; when it is enabled, any attempt to make an AMI public is blocked, but AMIs that are already public stay public.

evidence.quote: ¹ If your account had one or more public AMIs on or after July 15, 2023, **Block public access for AMIs** is disabled by default for your account, even if you subsequently made all the AMIs private.
When block public access is enabled, any attempt to make an AMI public is automatically blocked. However, if you already have public AMIs, they remain publicly available.

qualifiers.condition: disabled by default if the account had a public AMI on or after July 15, 2023
